notes.title: CASTLE BATTLES "SEQUEL" COMING TO EARLY ACCESS
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

It has been a long time since we reached out to the warriors of Castleland. First, I'd like to thank every one of you for playing our humble indie game that first released Dec 16, 2016. Your feedback, support, and encouragement gave us the ability to keep our little indie studio moving forward over the years.

And now we're back with wonderful news!

Over the last few years we have been building on Castle Battle's solid foundation to create something much more ambitions than we were ever capable of before now...

[b]IT STARES BACK[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1094250/It_Stares_Back/

Our next title once again takes place within the world of the Great Tapestry. You might even see a few familiar faces on your perilous journey. Though I must warn you, much has changed since the age of the Castle Battles.

[b]For more updates[/b], join our vibrant Discord community where we develop in real time:
[url=https://discord.gg/3Jfc7C2]CHOOSE YOUR FACTION[/url]

May your mustache guide you to victory!
Cleveland T. Mosher, Light Arc Studio

notes.title: SUMMER SALE AND DEV UPDATES
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27149468/910ac5b6e2fd018155c68dc9792b10e3dfbda4a1.png[/img]
Hey there Battlers of Castles, 
Light Arc Studio here with several big news updates:

First, a shameless plug:
WE ARE IN STEAM'S SUMMER SALE AT 50% OFF!!!!


Interview:
We were recently featured on another podcast, The Dorkening's Ultimate Video Game Show! Check out their new series where we talk about Castle Battles game-play and it's development process: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SskCpxa4MHs&t


Dev updates:
We've heard a lot of fantastic ideas and feedback from the community. These comments were often pared with the question, "Are you planning on doing anything else with the game?" Our response has generally been "we want to, but early sales will have to justify it." 

Well good news! Because of your remarkable support our audience has steadily grown! Particularly this has been the case on Google Play's marketplace as their review algorithm has continued to feature us in response to positive community ratings. Turns out we weren't kidding when we said every voice counts!

See for yourself:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/d...c.castle&hl=en

What does this mean? 

Short term: A patch is coming in the next few weeks to enhance some basic ui and visual elements. It won't be multiplayer or more story as we want to build on our strong mechanical foundation for future projects first. We're not saying it will never happen (we are looking for ways), but Multiplayer is a massive undertaking and we don't have access to those resources... yet.

Long term: We're chuck full of ideas for what comes next, but we don't want to get ahead of ourselves and start a runaway hype train riddled with broken promises. We will keep you updated as our many ideas solidify into something we are confident is press worthy. Feel free to chime in as we reveal more!

TLDR; Things are starting to go well at Light Arc, so keep sharing the good word of Castle Battles with your friends!

notes.title: CASTLE BATTLES: Now availiable on Android and IOS!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27149468/def3b611e4b45e3c09af39bbf8ef39252e85cbde.png[/img]

The time has finally arrived!

Download the mobile version today and receive the first campaign of our action-strategy RPG for free!!!

Derbyshire, UK - April 25, 2017 - Enter The Great Tapestry! Light Arc Studio, a developer and publisher of interactive entertainment,today announced that their fast-paced action-strategy RPG, Castle Battles, is now available on the Apple App Store and Google Play for iOS and Android devices.
 
As a special introductory treat for battle-hungry iOS and Android players, Light Arc Studio is giving away the entire first campaign, consisting of 10 levels, for FREE! Players can weave their fate into The Great Tapestry by unlocking the remaining 3 campaigns (adding 30 additional levels) for only $4.99, or individually at $1.99 each. 

Google Play:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lightarc.castle

Apple App Store:
https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/id1210311968

Watch the Castle Battles: Mobile Launch Trailer at https://youtu.be/2j-xM2Z7zTU

We'll be doing a big mobile announcement tomorrow, but here is the Apple App store link as well:

Enjoy! 
Cleveland T. Mosher, Writer / Illustrator at Light Arc Studio

notes.title: New Patch, Trailer, and Mobile Release Announcement
notes.notes:
That's right folks, 
CASTLE BATTLES IS COMING TO IOS AND ANDROID! APRIL 25TH, 2017!!!

Plus, we put out a fat PATCH that'll get yall battling like never before!

As we've prepped for the mobile version of the game, we've been listening to community feedback. Now we've added a few features to improve play.

- First, there is now an option to turn off the trippy, blur effect. We heard some players were straining their eyes at times during gameplay. Now if you encounter this issue, you can simply turn it off and keep battling.

- Second, we added a cheat option to skip levels. You still "don't deserve an easy mode," but if you're more inclined to finish the story than personally beat every level, you can now do so. 

- Third, a bevy of minor enhancements to play and bug fixes. We also put out a linux version of the game. Let us know if you encounter any issues with it in the forum.

Once again,
CASTLE BATTLES IS COMING TO IOS AND ANDROID! APRIL 25TH, 2017!!!

Check out the sweet new trailer and tell your fam:
 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zTIPfk32XcU&t
